wood.traits: Growth, kindness, reach — you expand, and things come alive around you.
wood.balanceNote: your energy flows upward into light — a name that carries flame

fire.traits: Visibility, warmth, momentum — you start things and people gather.
fire.balanceNote: your flame settles into ground — a name that anchors

earth.traits: Trust, patience, load-bearing calm — people build on you.
earth.balanceNote: your ground refines into an edge — a name with clean clarity

metal.traits: Precision, principle, cut — you keep what works and remove the rest.
metal.balanceNote: your edge deepens into reflection — a name with still depth

water.traits: Depth, adaptability, quiet persistence — you outlast by flowing.
water.balanceNote: your depth feeds living growth — a name that greens
